blocks.text: Hadhrat Naafi reports that Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) used to turn his animal's head while travelling the road to Makkah (to turn the animal in different directions). Turning the animal, he would say, "(I am doing this) So that the footstep (of my animal) falls on the footstep (of Rasulullaah ﷺ's animal)."[^2]
Hadhrat Naafi says, "If you had to see Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) following in the footsteps of Rasulullaah ﷺ, you would say that he is mad."[^3]
Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) says, "There was none who followed so meticulously the footsteps of Rasulullaah ﷺ in all his stops (during his travels) as Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) did."[^4]

Another narration states that if anyone had to see Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) follow in the footsteps of Rasulullaah ﷺ, they would think that his mind was affected. Hadhrat Naafi says, "No camel that has lost her little one in a desert searches as thoroughly as Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) does when searching for the footsteps of Rasulullaah ﷺ."[^5]

blocks.narrator: Hadhrat Abdur Rahmaan bin Umayyah bin Abdullaah
blocks.text: Hadhrat Abdur Rahmaan bin Umayyah bin Abdullaah reports that he once asked Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA), "We find the salaah of fear and the salaah of a resident in the Qur'aan, but do not find the salaah of a traveller?" Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) replied, "Allaah sent his Nabi ﷺ (to guide us) when we were the most unrefined people. We therefore do as Rasulullaah ﷺ did."[^6]

blocks.narrator: Hadhrat Umayyah bin Abdullaah bin Khaalid bin Usayd
blocks.text: Hadhrat Umayyah bin Abdullaah bin Khaalid bin Usayd reports that he once asked Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA), "In the Qur'aan we find mention of shortening the salaah of fear but do not find the shortening of the traveller's salaah?" Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) replied, "We found our Nabi ﷺ doing something and we did the same."[^7]

Hadhrat Waarid bin Abu Aasim reports that he once met Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) in Mina and asked him about the salaah performed on a journey. When Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) replied that it was only two Rakaahs, Hadhrat Waarid asked, "What is your opinion now that we are here in Mina?" This infuriated Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) and he said, "Shame on you! Have you heard about Rasulullaah ﷺ?" Hadhrat Waarid replied, "Certainly, and I believe in him." Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) then said, "Whenever Rasulullaah ﷺ went on a journey, he would perform two Rakaahs salaah. You may therefore perform two Rakaahs or leave it out."[^8]
